evals.name: trigger-suno-prompt
evals.prompt: suno prompt for a nostalgic synth-pop track about leaving town at dusk
evals.expected_output: Routes to the prompt action. Builds a complete style prompt using the 6-layer formula (genre, mood, instrumentation, vocal direction, numeric BPM, production) plus tagged lyrics. Does not generate audio.
expectations: Recognizes a Suno prompt-craft request and routes to `prompt`
Emits a style prompt that uses the 6-layer order rather than a free-form paragraph
Includes tagged lyrics or offers the lyrics companion rather than skipping the lyrics field
Does not claim to produce or play audio

evals.name: trigger-write-suno-lyrics
evals.prompt: write suno lyrics for a folk chorus titled 'Red River Coat'
evals.expected_output: Routes to the lyrics action. Emits section-tagged lyrics with vocal and performance tags, not an untagged poem. Stays inside prompt-craft: no audio generation.
expectations: Routes to `lyrics` rather than the full `prompt` style+lyrics builder unless the user also asked for a style prompt
Uses Suno section tags such as [Verse] / [Chorus]
Does not dump an untagged lyric block as the only output

evals.name: trigger-fix-garbled-lyrics
evals.prompt: fix garbled lyrics, Suno swallowed the pre-chorus and the BPM is ignored
evals.expected_output: Routes to the troubleshoot action. Diagnoses the named symptoms (absorbed section, BPM ignored) from context/troubleshoot.md and proposes a prompt-side rewrite, not a new audio render.
expectations: Addresses both named symptoms rather than only one
Proposes prompt or tag changes rather than offering to regenerate audio in Suno
